title: Astre
description: Asteroids, back from 1979 — on a warm cream sky. An inertial rocket, rocks that split three ways, a field that wraps at every edge. v1.1.0 pours on the fun: round power-up badges drop from the wrecks — triple fire, a one-hit shield, slow-motion rocks, a rare golden extra life — plus hit-stop impacts, pop-fragmentation, floating scores, combo stickers, an animated sun and colored stars, a smoothed 60 fps render and a heartbeat that races as the wave thins. Dash with immunity, combo chains up to ×8 with a slow-motion beat, hunting drones and a 12-HP mega-rock every fourth wave. Keyboard and touch, in English, French and Spanish.
controls: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD/ZQSD; Space fires; Shift dashes along your nose; P pauses.
On touch: a left stick steers the rocket (push far to thrust), FIRE and DASH buttons on the right.
The rocket keeps drifting — short bursts, calm hands. The sky wraps around at every edge.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
